name: Exposure Training
body:
You have learned how to make the most out of any situation, even ones you’re not specifically trained for.

Prerequisite(s): commando conditioning class feature*, evasion class feature.

Benefit(s): Once per day as an immediate action when you attempt a saving throw that your conditioning bonus doesn’t apply to, you can apply your highest conditioning bonus to that saving throw.

Character Options: The Ranger. © 2025, Far Distant Future Publishing; Author: Bryan Mangum.
